scope: One U-Boot RAM boot; bounded idle, single-core load, and two-core load at fixed inherited rail voltage

hotplug_cleanup.event: CPU1 offlining immediately after two-core load caused a kernel panic
hotplug_cleanup.fault: pwrdm_get_valid_lp_state() via omap4_hotplug_cpu() dereferenced a NULL CPU1 powerdomain pointer
hotplug_cleanup.cause: The RAM board policy skips omap2_common_pm_late_init(), and thus omap4_mpuss_init(), while CPU hotplug remains enabled.

limits: The two-core 350 MHz run lasted only ten seconds; no long-duration stability or workload-energy qualification was performed.
The measured current difference is one INA snapshot at fixed voltage, not a whole-device power comparison.
The likely MPU channel assignment follows software evidence; no PCB net was measured.
Voltage scaling, automatic governor, CPU1 hotplug, and higher OPPs remain unqualified.
